## Load Libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library("petersenlab")
library("psych")
library("nFactors")
library("GGally")
library("tidyverse")
```

## Specify Options

```{r}

```

## Load Data

Load the data file that is in the following location: `./Data/nfl_actualStats_team.RData` (if running locally) or `../Data/nfl_actualStats_team.RData` (if rendering).

```{r}
#| eval: false

load(file = "./Data/nfl_actualStats_team.RData") # if running locally
```

```{r}
load(file = "../Data/nfl_actualStats_team.RData") # if "rendering" (which uses the Analyses folder as the relative path)
```

## Prepare Data

```{r}
nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg$fumbles_lost <- rowSums(nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[,c("sack_fumbles_lost","rushing_fumbles_lost","receiving_fumbles_lost")])

pcaVars <- c(
  "passing_yards","passing_tds","passing_interceptions","passing_epa","passing_cpoe",
  "rushing_yards","rushing_tds","rushing_epa",
  "receiving_epa","fumbles_lost"
)

dataForPCA <- nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg

# Standardize variables for PCA
dataForPCA[pcaVars] <- scale(dataForPCA[pcaVars])
```

# Correlation Matrix

```{r}
petersenlab::cor.table(
  nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[,pcaVars]
)

GGally::ggcorr(
  nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg[,pcaVars],
  label = TRUE,
  label_round = 2)
```

# Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

## Determine Number of Components

Determine the number of components to retain.

### Scree Plots

```{r}
psych::fa.parallel(
  x = dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  fa = "pc"
)

screeDataEFA <- nFactors::nScree(
  x = cor(
    dataForPCA[pcaVars],
    use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
  model = "components")

nFactors::plotnScree(screeDataEFA)
```

### Very Simple Structure (VSS) Plot

```{r}
psych::vss(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  rotate = "oblimin",
  fm = "pc")

psych::nfactors(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  rotate = "oblimin",
  fm = "pc")
```

## Fit Models

```{r}
pca1ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 1,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca2ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 2,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca3ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 3,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca4ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 4,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca5ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 5,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca6ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 6,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca7ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 7,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca8ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 8,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca9ComponentOblique <- psych::principal(
  dataForPCA[pcaVars],
  nfactors = 9,
  rotate = "oblimin")

pca1ComponentOblique
pca2ComponentOblique
pca3ComponentOblique
pca4ComponentOblique
pca5ComponentOblique
pca6ComponentOblique
pca7ComponentOblique
pca8ComponentOblique
pca9ComponentOblique
```

## Component Scores

Here we extract the component scores from the one-component model:

```{r}
dataMergedWithPCA <- cbind(nfl_actualStats_team_seasonal_reg, pca1ComponentOblique$scores)
```

Component scores for the first six players:

```{r}
pca1ComponentOblique$scores %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```

## Identify the Best and Worst Offenses

### Best Offenses

Which teams (in a given season) have had the best offense?

```{r}
dataMergedWithPCA %>% 
  arrange(-PC1) %>% 
  select(season, team, PC1, all_of(pcaVars)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```

### Worst Offenses

Which teams (in a given season) have had the worst offense?

```{r}
dataMergedWithPCA %>% 
  arrange(PC1) %>% 
  select(season, team, PC1, all_of(pcaVars)) %>% 
  na.omit() %>% 
  head()
```
